messages:
marta: Heads up — Acme legal pushing for an 'escape hatch' that lets them drop to a lower commitment mid-pilot without penalty. They framed it as an enterprise pilot requirement.

sahil: do we have precedent? I thought we avoided mid-commit escapes bc of capacity planning. :thinking_face:

jen: few deals had a negotiated opt-out but always with a notice window + usage floor. e.g., 30d notice + 50% of min commit as break fee.

kai: For starter tiers specifically, we could offer a timebound pilot clause: no-break fee for first 60 days, then standard commit applies. keeps ops risk low.

marta: Acme wants flexibility after 30d. They argue early usage is spiky and they don't want a full commit if product-market-fit isn't there.

dave: Tradeoff: capacity placement for Dedicated and pricing uplift assumptions. If we allow 30d free exit we need a guardrail: max burst credits, hard per-route QPS limit, and no priority lane.

sahil: propose: 30d opt-out + capped burst credits (10k tokens/day) + rate-limited endpoints. If they exceed cap we auto-upgrade to paid baseline or pause.

jen: can we express as add-on: "pilot-escape" feature with limited capacity? that way it's explicit in contract and product checks for limits.

marta: Contract language sketch: 
```
Pilot Escape Clause:
- Valid for first 30 days from activation.
- Eligible accounts receive 10k daily burst tokens and standard rate-limits.
- Early exit requires 7d notice; if usage exceeded thresholds, account billed at prorated baseline.
```

kai: ops needs the exact thresholds. Also need a rollout plan for Console UX + billing flags.

pricing-bot: New draft: pilot-escape v0.1 created at https://go/rw/pricing-drafts/pilot-escape-v0.1 (internal) :page_with_curl:

marta: Launch criteria proposal:
- Legal sign-off on clause
- Backend enforcement for daily token cap + rate limits
- Console toggle to enable pilot-escape per account
- Docs + SE playbook
- Limits telemetry + alerting for >75% cap usage within 7 days

dave: timeline: ops can ship enforcement in 3 sprints if prioritized (approx 6 weeks). Console toggle + docs + sales script another 2 weeks.

sahil: commercial ask: let sales offer pilot-escape only to named accounts and cap total seats under the program for first quarter. prevents abuse.

jen: question for product: do we attach a price to the add-on if customer wants extended escape (e.g., 60d)?

marta: yes — extended escape becomes a paid addon: +15% list on top of baseline for extra 30d. keeps incentives aligned.

kai: technical note: enforcement should be idempotent and triggered at token generation path. suggest lightweight middleware that checks account flags and caps, returns 429 when exceeded, and emits metric tags: pilot_escape:true.

dave: also need an automated billing hook so that if they exceed aggregate thresholds we can invoice prorated baseline automatically.

sahil: next steps: marta to draft contract language + commercial guardrails. kai/dave to scope engineering work and confirm rollout timeline. jen to draft SE script and docs. I'll queue a pilot cohort cap proposal for revenue ops.

marta: agreed. I'll post the legal draft by EOD tomorrow and schedule a 30m sync Thurs to finalize launch checklist. thanks all :pray:
